input.justification: Option 1A has the lowest total compensation (CHF 95) and the highest net uplift (CHF 590), and both bumps are only one day. Atelier Rochat (CHF 50, one day, flexible up to 4 days, exhibition three weeks away) and Studio Meier Licht (CHF 45, one day, flexible up to 5 days, already prepaid) both have plenty of slack. Keller, Alpine Drone Works and Vuilleumier were excluded because they are not flexible.

input.message:
Bonjour Monsieur Rochat,

Nous devons traiter une urgence pour un autre client. Auriez-vous la gentillesse de reporter la livraison de vos pièces (J-2044) à mercredi au lieu de mardi ? En compensation, nous vous versons CHF 50, directement par une réduction de la capture sur votre autorisation PayPal existante.

Merci beaucoup de votre compréhension.
Werkstatt Reuss
input.message_en: Dear Mr. Rochat, we need to handle an emergency for another customer. Would you kindly move the delivery of your parts (J-2044) to Wednesday instead of Tuesday? As compensation we will pay you CHF 50, charged as a reduced capture on your existing PayPal authorization. Thank you very much for your understanding. Werkstatt Reuss

input.message:
Grüezi Frau Meier

Wir müssen einen Notfall für einen anderen Kunden bearbeiten. Dürfen wir Ihre Lampenschirme (J-2047) um einen Tag verschieben, also von Mittwoch auf Donnerstag? Als Entschädigung erhalten Sie CHF 45 per PayPal-Auszahlung, da Sie bereits im Voraus bezahlt haben.

Vielen Dank für Ihr Verständnis.
Werkstatt Reuss
input.message_en: Dear Ms. Meier, we need to handle an emergency for another customer. May we move your lamp shades (J-2047) by one day, from Wednesday to Thursday? As compensation you will receive CHF 45 by PayPal Payout, since you prepaid. Thank you for your understanding. Werkstatt Reuss
